model_rejection.reason_en: Reported historical earnings and TTM revenue cross a business-perimeter discontinuity; continuing operations are loss-making, financing-dependent and subject to extreme dilution. Conventional PER or historical FCFF extrapolation would be economically misleading.
model_rejection.reason_ko: 과거 보고이익과 TTM 매출은 사업범위 단절을 가로지르며 계속사업은 적자·자금조달 의존·극심한 희석위험 상태다. 전통적 PER 또는 과거 FCFF 연장은 경제적으로 오도할 수 있다.

reconciliation_notes.cash: June 30 cash of $10.609m is pre-spin consolidated cash; $5.3m was transferred to SpinCo at closing, so the headline net-cash figure is not treated as a downside floor.
reconciliation_notes.dilution: Current 3.56m shares are only a snapshot; H1 ATM financing and +230.47% QoQ share change require explicit future diluted-share assumptions.
reconciliation_notes.business_perimeter: SEC Separation pro-forma financials are preferred to historical consolidated results for continuing-business economics.
reconciliation_notes.transactions: FLYX distribution is historical shareholder consideration, while the July 15 RTO LOI is non-binding and excluded from core expected value.
